correctness.rationale: Part (a) is a correct rigorous textbook proof: leading coefficient (-lambda)^n omega^{n(n-1)/2} has modulus (3/2)^n, Jensen-Mahler identity gives (1/n)int log||M_n||>=log(3/2) for every n and E, Kingman limit preserves it, hence L(E)>=log(3/2) uniformly. Part (b) as a finite-grid statement was independently replayed: python3 inputs/artifacts/verify.py prints Herman edge 0.355465, grid 41x400=16400 resonant 140 frac 0.00854 worst slice 13/400 good 96.75%, VERIFY_OK, matching DRAFT and resonant_log.csv (140 rows, max per-E 13). Code correctly forms H-E with V=3cos(2pi(n alpha+theta)) and C=max(log|G|+0.30|x-y|). DRAFT honestly limits (b) to grid level with no interval arithmetic and no continuum enclosure, distinguishing proof (a) from computed witness (b).

originality.rationale: Part (a) alone is textbook Herman 1983 (admitted in DRAFT section 5 remark): L>=log(3/2) for 3cos=2*(3/2)cos uniformly, stronger than claimed log(3/2)-0.05. Originality therefore rests on the conjunction with the explicit N=80 Green-decay ledger (rate 0.30, C*=8.0, 41x400 grid, 140 explicitly listed resonant pairs). Fused three-direction search (literal N=80/0.30 claim, equivalent 2lambda/Aubry-dual/Harper encodings, dominance via Bourgain-Goldstein-Schlag avalanche/LDT/Green monographs and databases) found no source tabulating this window, threshold, scale, or resonance log. General avalanche/LDT/Green theorems give asymptotic N0 without explicit N=80 constants and do not imply the grid ledger. Hence the exact conjunction/ledger is literally new, though (a) alone is a corollary of known stronger fact.

value.rationale: Value FAILS as textbook restatement plus unexplained enumeration. Conjunct (a) is admitted classical Herman bound, reproved, not new. Conjunct (b) is a 10-second double-precision enumeration on an arbitrary grid (41 E x 400 theta, N=80 not Fibonacci, rate 0.30, C*=8.0 large, 1.5% gate) with no interval arithmetic and explicitly no grid-to-continuum enclosure. It therefore does not constitute the claimed multiscale-analysis input for localization, which requires uniform continuum bounds off a small-measure set; between grid points resonances are unenclosed. The thresholds and grid are post-hoc tuned to pass VERIFY_OK, not motivated before computation, and the resulting statistic (140/16400 resonant) is grid-dependent, not a reusable exact invariant of the natural operator that a future researcher could need. Recomputation is trivial. Certification alone in double precision does not rescue an arbitrary scope. This is precisely mere parameter substitution and unexplained enumeration, even though correct and new.
